items.criterion: Use the correct Hugging Face repository page (meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct) and rely on visible metadata
items.description: Agent navigates to the specified Hugging Face model repository (starting URL is acceptable) and uses the page’s visible metadata (not guesses from the model name). Full credit if the agent clearly indicates the info comes from the repo page UI/metadata. Partial credit if the correct repo is used but evidence/source is unclear. No credit if the agent reports metadata for a different repo or appears to infer details without viewing the page.

items.criterion: Report the license name from repository metadata
items.description: Agent records the license name exactly as shown in the repository’s visible metadata. Full credit if license is correctly stated. Partial credit if license is approximately correct but not clearly tied to visible metadata. Full credit also if the agent cannot view the license due to an access/login wall and explicitly reports that blocker rather than guessing. No credit for guessing or reporting an incorrect license when the page shows it.

items.criterion: Report the current likes count from repository metadata
items.description: Agent records the current likes count as shown on the repository page. Full credit if the number matches the visible likes count at time of viewing. Partial credit if the agent reports a likes count but does not make clear it was read from the page. Full credit if the likes count is not visible due to a gating/login blocker and the agent reports that limitation. No credit for fabricated/guessed counts.

items.criterion: Determine whether the repository is gated (from visible UI evidence)
items.description: Agent states whether the repository is gated, using visible evidence (e.g., prompts indicating access request/acceptance required). Full credit if gated vs not-gated is correctly identified with clear evidence. Partial credit if correct but evidence is not described. Full credit if gating status cannot be verified due to access restrictions and the agent reports the uncertainty/blocker instead of guessing. No credit for incorrect or assumed gating status.

Agent does not sign in, does not request access, and does not download model files. Agent stops after recording license, likes, and gated-status evidence (no extra steps beyond what’s needed). Full credit if all constraints are respected and the agent stops appropriately. Partial credit if minor unnecessary navigation occurs but constraints are still respected. No credit if the agent signs in, requests access, or attempts downloads.
